## Source: kam193 (e623272b4de65cc8af24a44d5405d9f6baa2c42896b50f9b7e0e5f294bfd2722)
During installation, the package deploys a rogue AWS Lambda function to collect credentials from Secret Manager as well as collect other data. Data are then exfiltrated.

 - The package overrides the install command in setup.py to execute malicious code during installation.
